n_main.text:
Editor workspace. Shows the panel layout: tab strip docked left with Close and Open every tab, map, Fill tool, floating Block palette group, floating toolbar, snackbar.
Try: Tweaks dark, showFloat, showDrop, seed, motion; click tabs, tools, toolbar modes.
In the app: panels, map, the five tools, history, notes, language chips. Also: a Biome tool, world presets, a Tools tab (its own board), the Side view panel, structure files (.nbt save and place, undoable), the Blocks panel and the floating map toolbar with Pan, Select, Pick block, Measure and Go to. Not in the app yet: per-element appearance. Also: right-click map menu (also Menu key, Shift+F10, long-press) with its own regex-builder search; every dropdown opens the same searchable menu; 3D view, side view, biome tool, structures, exports; the map keeps its view when you leave and return; Bedrock Edition worlds open and edit with the same tools (blocks picked from the map, or air). Every button now carries an icon chosen from its own words; narrow map panels show icon-only tools; badges on tool cards and deploy targets; lists as soft tiles. Shell redesigned: one raised stage on a tinted frame, slim sticky header with a morphing logo and a single language switch, tab list with an icon per destination and a filled shaped pill for the current one, denser tool fields, a note-sized notes box. Third redesign pass: flat surface, slim navigation rail (icon pill with label beneath), picture-first world cards, floating rounded workspace panels with pill tabs, even tool grid, one field shape. Since then: the map right-click menu in the desktop app offers Open world folder in an outside editor or the file manager. Messages that say editing or tabs are locked carry an Unlock button; messages survive a redraw.

n_worlds.text:
Worlds screen with every stage. Try: the search chips above the cards (island, 1.21, nether, Clear); Tweak stage (list, loading, empty, upload, error, offline), dark, seed, motion.
Stands for: upload a world .zip to the web app or appliance, new flat world, download .zip, browse a folder in the desktop app.
Being built; nothing here is verified in the app until the handoff says so. Also: upload, download, new world from six presets in four sizes; Bedrock Edition worlds are listed and open for editing (LevelDB reader, new log file per save, never rewrites a file). Not checked: a Bedrock world opened in the game after an edit. Third redesign pass: flat surface, slim navigation rail (icon pill with label beneath), picture-first world cards, floating rounded workspace panels with pill tabs, even tool grid, one field shape. Since then: Select mode on the Worlds screen (tick boxes, Shift+click range, Ctrl+A, Select all, Invert, Download selected). Also: Move to bin for ticked worlds (two-key confirmation, nothing deleted, a line says what was skipped) and a Bin with Put back.

n_worldsselect.text:
Select mode and the bin on the Worlds screen. Try: tick worlds, Select all, Invert, Move to bin (the open world is skipped and the line says so), then Put back; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: tick boxes with Shift+click and Ctrl+A, Download selected, Move to bin behind the two-key confirmation, a bin folder inside the worlds folder, nothing ever deleted.

n_firstrun.text:
First-run wizard. Try: click steps, Back, Next, Skip, language cards, and on the last step Make a practice world now and Try it failing; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Stands for the in-app onboarding wizard: language and voice, comfort modes, theme colour, open a world; progress saves and resumes.
Being built; the owner account already exists as the sign-up screen. Sign-in is now a two-part screen: an expressive panel (headline, three points with icons, moving blocks that stop under reduced motion) beside the form; one column on phones.

n_history.text:
Edit history. Try: action filter chips, select a point; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Stands for the private Git history kept beside app data, append-only restore.
In the app: Edits and Details panels with their own saved layout, list, search, From and To dates, action filters with counts, shown count, details with full commit id, roll back, copy commit id. Also: Open as a copy, per-point stats and an Activity panel (accounts, settings, extensions, worlds; also with no world open). Filters fold away behind Hide filters, remembered, with a count of filters still on. Since then: tick edits or activity rows to export just those (Shift+click range, Select all, Invert).

n_settings.text:
Settings. Try: an Account and passkeys section, palette teleport to every setting, section tabs, language buttons, switches (each says whether its value is the built-in choice or your own change, and names the built-in one), seed swatches; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: an Account and passkeys section, palette teleport to every setting, section tabs, settings search across sections, language, both funny sliders, dark, theme colour picker, reduce motion, large text, sound effects with volume and a test sound, export, import, settings history with Restore, Clear buttons on every text field, read messages aloud with speed and a test, dark theme on a schedule, Lock editing, Extensions section. Also: a lock on every switch (locked switches are disabled here and refused in the palette), Quiet hours for sounds and reading aloud. Also: Lock panel layout, Keep every tab open, Lock the Settings screen with an Unlock banner. Emoji in dialogs switch: not needed, the app uses drawn icons instead of emoji in its dialogs. Also: authenticator app codes, unlock ladder, a tone per part and your own logo, vocabulary upload, Focus and School modes, part-colour dropdowns as searchable menus. Authenticator set-up now shows a QR code drawn in the page with the key hidden until asked; a vocabulary file dropped anywhere applies with a level-up. Each setting is a soft tile; Name of this app (rename with reset) and an emoji-in-dialogs switch were added. Since then, in the desktop app under Backup and history: the data folder with its size, Open, Copy path and a safe Move (copy, check, restart), plus More worlds folders.

n_regexbuilder.text:
Every search field in the app: plain text by default, .* turns regex on for that field only, the builder sits beside it. Try: .* switch, builder button, presets (Invalid and Too slow show the error states), insert tokens, flags; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: settings, history, changelog and palette searches; worker-isolated ECMAScript engine with 250 ms stop; raw pattern and field synced both ways; flags i m s u; sample with highlights and capture groups; copy and export; nothing saved. Also: Find tabs with its own builder, Close tabs containing text and Close tabs not containing text (one predicate, count, preview, empty and invalid queries refused, last tab and running edits kept). Also: the board's ready-made pattern chips (Starts with Fill or Replace, Sizes, Commit ids, Block names, Dates); the demo-only Invalid and Too slow chips stay on the board.

n_extensions.text:
Extensions manager in Settings. Try: switch Spawn platform on to see the consent dialog, Cancel or Allow; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: manifest.json v1 per folder, out-of-process JSON-lines protocol, permissions world-info, selection, edit-world with consent tied to the exact set (changes ask again), 10 s and 1 MiB limits, clean environment with no secrets or paths, edits through the recorded history path, searchable manager with its own regex builder, palette commands, two built-in extensions, author article with Node and Python samples, master switch, add from .zip (and from a folder in the desktop app) asking before replacing, remove, reload, open extensions folder, recent runs, consent again on any version or permission change. Also: Add from link (https .zip). Also: Add from link checks an optional published SHA-256 and reports the download's SHA-256. Not yet: code-signed extension sources. Since then: tick extension cards to export or switch off just those; Switch off has a power icon.

n_palette.text:
Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+F) with live setting rows, notification centre, Update coming soon, dim sum surprise. Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: palette with live switches and its own regex builder, notification centre, update flow: background download shown in About, ready-to-install banner with version, release notes, unsigned note, Later and Restart. Dim sum surprise in the app: 1 in 10 at start after setup, corner card with bilingual name, jyutping and description from the public catalogue, Public image unavailable placeholder (photos are only published encrypted), closes after 9 s unless hovered, switch in Settings and palette. Also: the Update coming soon card with an indeterminate bar and Hide while the download runs, in the editor and the deploy app.

n_takeover.text:
Install success and failure takeovers for the deploy app. Try: Tweak state, seed, motion.
In the deploy app: both takeovers as drawn. Success: link, version, time taken, Open, Copy link, closes after 8 s unless hovered or focused. Failure: stays, step log with the exact error, Try port N+1 when the port is taken (else Try again), Copy details, Dismiss; focus kept inside, Esc closes. The editor app uses the same shared takeover for world uploads (Ready to edit, Open in the editor; failure with the exact reason, Choose another, Copy details), switchable in Settings › Comfort. Two-key confirmation for destructive actions: card slams in over moving hazard stripes, two keys then a full slide, Emergency exit always there; still under reduced motion.

n_phone.text:
Phone width: panels collapse to one group with chips; bottom destinations. Try: panel chips, destinations; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: one tabbed panel group under 720 px with its own saved layout, compact header, bottom destinations with icon pills. Also: the panel chips row (a tab list with arrow keys) replaces the group's own tab strip on phones. Also: the floating map toolbar sits above the bottom destinations (it was underneath; fixed), long-press opens the map menu.

n_deploy.text:
Deploy app. Try: target cards, press Deploy to watch the steps run (the button is off meanwhile), Deploy and Instances views, the Messages button (its count clears when opened), School mode (the bar appears and Deploy stops answering), the instance search chips; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: Docker, Docker on another computer over SSH (DOCKER_HOST=ssh, own key, no passwords), VirtualBox and USB flash targets, Raspberry Pi pointing to the SSH route, instance list with Manage, success and failure takeovers. Real-world checks after every release: Docker local and over SSH (deploy, health, stop, start, restart, update, live log, remove) and USB flash with read-back passed on real Docker and a loop device; the Windows app updated itself from the previous release. Also: VMware Workstation or Player (ovftool import on a bridged network, vmrun start without a window, address from the guest tools, manage). Pi image built in CI (Pi 4 and 5), container checked for arm64, booted on QEMU raspi4b to the health check (not yet on a physical Pi) and offered through USB drive. Also: Duplicate on a Docker instance (same computer, version and worlds, suggested free name and port, fresh accounts; virtual machines explain why not). Also: Virtual disks view for Windows (list, new .vhdx or .vhd, attach, attach read-only, detach through diskpart with the Windows permission prompt, result checked afterwards, nothing deleted), Duplicate, activity record, exports. Not checked: the Virtual disks view on a real Windows PC. Every button now carries an icon chosen from its own words; narrow map panels show icon-only tools; badges on tool cards and deploy targets; lists as soft tiles. Since then: the wizard has a language switch (English, Cantonese, both), a command palette, first-run onboarding and a sound button. Also: a Guide view with the bundled articles, and Instances can be ticked to start, stop or restart together with a report. The wizard has the same support desk.

n_deploymanage.text:
Deploy app instance management. Try: Tweak state (running, stopped, restarting), dark, seed, motion.
Stands for Open, Start or Stop, Restart, Update and Remove on a Docker instance the app created, plus a live log that follows docker compose logs.
Being built for the Docker target; not run against a real Docker host. Reworked: a status hero (name, state, version, link) with grouped actions beside a dark console for the live log; Remove goes through the two-key confirmation.

n_about.text:
About and changelog. Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Stands for version provenance from the running build and a changelog generated from the real commit history at build time, each entry with its SHA, searchable.
Being built. Also: the changelog search has its regex builder; Update coming soon card. Since then: a Guide tab bundles all 13 articles in the app, offline, in English, Cantonese or both, with its own search; the changelog and notifications export as CSV, JSON, Markdown or HTML. Also: each change opens to its full note (safe Markdown), and a release code name from the public dim sum catalogue sits under the version tiles. Report a problem now opens a support desk that lists exactly what is attached and keeps tickets on the device.

n_supportdesk.text:
Support desk, opened from About, the Help menu or the palette. Try: fold What is attached, Save ticket, Delete; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: the list of attached facts with the line saying nothing else is added, tickets kept on the device, Copy, Open as an issue; the deploy wizard has the same desk.

n_tour.text:
Guided Take a tour: coach card beside the real control with a highlight ring, Step N of M, Back, Skip this step, Next, Close. Try: Back, Skip, Next, Close; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: whole-app tour plus one per destination (Worlds, Editor, History, Settings, About), offered once after onboarding, reachable from the ? Help menu, Settings › Comfort and the palette, resumes where it stopped, focus moves to the control, Esc and arrow keys, screen-reader announcement, reduced motion, English and Cantonese. Steps whose control is off screen say so and offer to reveal it. The deploy app and the docs site have their own tours with the same card. Also: the appliance console shows a four-step text tour under its version and link (a console has no pointer to anchor a coach card).

n_tools.text:
Tools tab. Try: Encode and Decode; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: Base64 for text and files up to 20 MiB, JSON to TypeScript (lists merged, missing keys optional), coordinates (chunk, place in chunk, region file, Nether and Overworld), all in the page with a tour. Not yet: general file converter, Ollama suite, server manager. Also: file converter (PNG, JPEG, WebP; NBT to JSON), server.properties editor, local AI helper through Ollama (not tried against a running Ollama). Every button now carries an icon chosen from its own words; narrow map panels show icon-only tools; badges on tool cards and deploy targets; lists as soft tiles. Since then: a Sketch board with seven pens, a partial eraser, straight lines with Shift, undo and redo, and SVG or PNG export.

n_sketch.text:
Sketch board on the Tools tab. Try: pick a pen (the chosen one opens out to show its name), pick a colour, Undo, Clear; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: seven pens and an eraser that removes only what it touches, straight lines with Shift or the L lock, undo and redo, keys 1 to 7 and E, SVG and PNG export, kept on the device.

n_datafolder.text:
Desktop app, Settings, Backup and history: the data folder and extra worlds folders. Try: Move data folder, Use the built-in folder again, Add a worlds folder, Take off the list; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: the move copies everything, checks it, saves the choice and takes effect after a restart; the old folder is never deleted; extra worlds folders show their worlds without a restart.

n_ownwords.text:
Settings, Language and voice: your own words. Try: Upload words (stands for a good file), then each faulty file, then Back to the built-in words, then School mode; watch the section names at the top; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: one fault refuses the whole file and nothing changes; the message names the kind of fault only; the same dialog is in the deploy app behind the pencil button.

n_guide.text:
Guide tab: the articles bundled in the app, offline. Try: pick an article, press a search chip; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: all 13 articles in English, Cantonese or both, own search with the regex builder, related links, a palette row per article; the deploy wizard has the same view.

n_sitehome.text:
Docs site home on GitHub Pages. Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Built and deployed to match this board. Also: bundled fonts, favicon, article screenshots for the newest features. Also: the animated hero demo (select, fill, roll back; still under reduced motion). Also: phone PDF edition, Downloads page from the release list, interactive diagram. The site now has English, Cantonese and both in the header (all 13 articles written in both), a dockview article workspace on wide screens with Reset layout and Plain page, link-preview tags with a real screenshot, and the Windows installer linked from the hero.
